arrival_pattern: Poisson program arrivals; next round submits only after local previous completion + tool gap

assumptions.selection: All structurally valid 7..15-round tasks, final context >=6000 tokens, every prompt+output <=16000; no outcome/success filtering
assumptions.inputs: Complete original teacher chat-template tokens; no padding, truncation or content mixing
assumptions.tools: Original recorded tool intervals, unscaled; tool commands never executed
assumptions.outputs: Fixed teacher-visible budgets; cannot establish unknown-output prediction
assumptions.replication: One replay per original task; no duplicate task amplification
assumptions.resource_pool: GPU KV 6.75 GiB, CPU KV 6 GiB; unchanged from r25
assumptions.loading: Only initial Poisson intervals rescaled 0.12 -> 0.48 program/s
assumptions.tokenization: Complete raw trajectories re-encoded with local 4B tokenizer
assumptions.quality: Serving replay; not new autonomous SWE success
assumptions.future_information: No evaluation future values used by online policies

frontier.construction: two identity-defined first-arrival bursts near 0.4/2.8 s; first tool waits back-solved to a 4.8 s return burst; changed fields are arrival_s and turns[0].gap_after_s
